title: Back Mountain Chamber of Commerce holds business expo - NewsBreak
text:
By Margaret Roarty [email protected] ,
5 hours ago The Back Mountain Chamber of Commerce held its annual business expo on Wednesday, with over 50 vendors. Margaret Roarty | Times Leader DALLAS — The Back Mountain Chamber of Commerce held its annual Business Expo on Wednesday. Attendees were able to visit and connect with over 50 vendors from the local business community. The event was held at The Green at Irem and featured roundtable discussions on employment and financial services, artificial intelligence, and home services in addition to the expo. Attendees could discover products, try food samples, and enter to win a variety of raffle prizes.
